entries.name: sheader-constant-v3-accept#0
entries.description: Size-flagged ErgoTree (header 0x1b = v3 + size + const-seg) with one segregated constant of type SHeader (typeCode 0x68 = 104). SHeader's DataSerializer is gated on isV3OrLaterErgoTreeVersion, so at treeVersion >= 3 (the v6.0 era) the JVM PARSES the SHeader constant (as a CHeader via ErgoHeader.sigmaSerializer) and round-trips byte-IDENTICAL — where the v2 form (header 0x1a) rejects with "Not defined DataSerializer for type SHeader". The ACCEPT side of the SHeader-constant version boundary (positive twin of the v2 reject vectors unparsed_soft_fork_header_constant / Box.softfork_header_constant_reject). An impl that REJECTS this OVER-REJECTS a valid v6.0 SHeader constant; one that mangles the round-trip diverges on propositionBytes -> boxId.
